name: @office/client-sync
description: Office offline sync engine (OFF-029): the client-side offline sync protocol — disconnected mutations captured into a bounded LocalQueue with CLIENT-GENERATED deterministic operation ids (client id + local sequence + command fingerprint) and client-observed timestamps, causal/version tokens (the client's last-seen slice cursor) checked against the server's actual state for clean-apply vs conflict, exactly-once replay on reconnection (idempotency by operation id; interrupted drains resume without duplicates), and explicit conflict resolution — PROTECTED conflicts (material commercial state) are never auto-resolved; resolution is a typed explicit command that re-enters the queue discipline. Composes @office/sync's grants, project slices, operation registry, and conflict records. In-memory engine only — NO transport, NO network I/O, NO SQL; depends only on @office/sync, @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, and @office/events (the ledger shapes).
